CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_total_cartones_actual()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select coalesce((
    select case 
      when valore ~ '^[0-9]+$' then valore::integer
      else 0
    end
    from public.configuracion
    where clave = 'total_cartones'
    limit 1
  ), 0);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.limpiar_reservas_expiradas()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  DELETE FROM reservas_temporales WHERE expira_en < NOW();
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_listar_cartones_huerfanos(_min_age interval DEFAULT '00:05:00'::interval)
 RETURNS TABLE(numero bigint, cedula text, created_at timestamp with time zone, reserved_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  SELECT c.numero, c.cedula, c.created_at, c.reserved_at
  FROM public.cartones c
  WHERE COALESCE(c.reserved_at, c.created_at) < now() - _min_age
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.inscripciones i
      WHERE c.numero = ANY(i.cartones)
        AND i.estado IN ('pendiente', 'aprobado')
    )
  ORDER BY COALESCE(c.reserved_at, c.created_at) ASC;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_listar_respaldos()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, fecha timestamp with time zone, motivo text, compras integer, cartones integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not bingo_security.is_admin() and auth.role()<>'service_role' then raise exception 'No autorizado' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return query select s.id,s.created_at,s.reason,jsonb_array_length(s.payload->'inscripciones'),jsonb_array_length(s.payload->'cartones') from bingo_security.snapshots s order by s.created_at desc limit 30;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_respaldar_sorteo(_motivo text DEFAULT 'Respaldo manual'::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not bingo_security.is_admin() and auth.role()<>'service_role' then raise exception 'No autorizado' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return bingo_security.make_snapshot(_motivo);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.es_admin_bingo()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(auth.role()='authenticated' and auth.uid()='5121c2ba-c8f1-40f8-8b3e-130a75f60ac5'::uuid,false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bingo_security.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select auth.role()='authenticated' and auth.uid()='5121c2ba-c8f1-40f8-8b3e-130a75f60ac5'::uuid
$function$
